d: Alag-alag riports ke mutabik anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men 4 se 5 lakh logon ke aane ka anuman tha lekin kaha gaya ki bhir anuman ke aankre ko par kar gaee thi. tabhi to ganv tak pahunchne vali tamam sarken javab de gaee thin. lekin yahan sabse bara saval ye hai ki shadi men itne log pahunche kyon? sirph islie ki anant sinh ki beti ki shadi thi? ya phir islie ki anant sinh ne shadi ko ek niji karyakram ki jagah sarvajnik utsav ka rup de diya tha? daraasal anant sinh ki pahchan aur unke samarthakon ke bich unki lokapriyta ne is pure aayojan ko ek alag hi rang de diya tha. log sirph dulha…
